class.name: VertexAICommand
class.brief_description: A named, documented action the Vertex AI assistant can perform.
class.description: A VertexAICommand binds a human-readable name and description to a Callable handler. Set [member is_destructive] to [code]true[/code] for actions that change project files or scene state; the assistant will require an explicit confirmation before executing them.

method.name: to_dictionary
method.description: Returns a dictionary describing the command (name, description, is_destructive).

members.member: Human-readable description shown in command listings.
The Callable invoked when the command is executed.
If [code]true[/code], the command requires confirmation before execution.
The command name used to invoke it.
